answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The ivory is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the zenith. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on time-locked work history, published publicly on failure, idle agents bleed standing. What survives to the nectar is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
